targets.review_note: Minimum k such that shortestpath with atmostk zeroededges is <=target. Eachlayer adds one zero-cost edge then Dijkstra closes unchangededges. Thiscriterion is sufficient for exacttarget: continuously restore the selectededgecosts tooriginal; shortestpath is monotone integer-valued with eachunitincrement changing it byatmostone, so itreaches c. Atmostn-1 changes suffice. Allcostsnonnegative, cyclescannotimprove beyondsimplepaths.
